relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of noncanonical inflammasome can activate the NLRP3-caspase-4-mediated processing and secretion of IL-1β and IL-18, and induces the inflammatory cell death, pyroptosis, via gasdermin D cleavage and activation (59–62).

key_findings: Chikungunya patients show increased platelet P-selectin, PF4 and 12-HETE, plus platelet NLRP3, caspase 4 and cleaved IL-1beta, indicating platelet-inflammasome engagement.
Higher acute-phase platelet activation and soluble P-selectin were associated with progression to chronic joint/muscle pain.
